title: Lee Resolution to Confederation Timeline
learningObjectives: Sequence Lee Resolution events from the 1775 Philadelphia meeting through the 1777 confederation delay.
Describe the three parts of the Lee Resolution covering independence, alliances, and confederation.
Explain how Congress responded with committees and deferred votes in summer 1776.

evidence.quote: Its second meeting convened in Philadelphia in 1775.
On June 7, 1776, Richard Henry Lee of Virginia, introduced this resolution
acting under the instruction of the Virginia Convention.
On June 11, 1776, the Congress appointed three concurrent committees
one to draft a declaration of independence
On that date, Congress adopted the first part (the declaration).
New York cast no vote until the newly elected New York Convention upheld the Declaration of Independence on July 9, 1776.
The plan for making treaties was not approved until September of 1776;
the plan of confederation was delayed until November of 1777.
